title: Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.30065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (3H) alignment in English-centric settings, but these gains transfer poorly to low-resource languages due to cultural mismatches. Existing multilingual 3H benchmarks rely predominantly on automated translation or LLM based synthesis, propagating source-language biases while sacrificing local relevance. To address this gap, we introduce Pak3H1, the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for 3H alignment, comprising PakAlpaca (helpfulness), PakBeaverTails (harmlessness), and PakTruthfulQA (honesty). Our multi-stage pipeline integrates manual cultural adaptation and dictionary-guided post editing to prioritize native speaker judgment, ensuring both semantic fidelity and contextual authenticity. Zero-shot evaluations across multiple open and proprietary LLM architectures reveal systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps: helpf

translated_title: Pak3H：通过人工情境化的乌尔都语基准评估大语言模型对齐中文化错配的代价
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在以英语为中心的环境中展现出较强的有用性、无害性与诚实性（3H）对齐能力，但由于文化错配，这些成果难以迁移到低资源语言。现有的多语言3H基准主要依赖自动翻译或基于大语言模型的合成方法，在传播源语言偏见的同时牺牲了本地相关性。为填补这一空白，我们推出了Pak3H——首个经人工验证、具有文化情境化的乌尔都语3H对齐基准套件，包含PakAlpaca（有用性）、PakBeaverTails（无害性）和PakTruthfulQA（诚实性）。我们的多阶段流程融合了人工文化适配与词典引导的后编辑，以母语使用者的判断为优先，确保语义忠实性与情境真实性。在多个开源与专有LLM架构上的零样本评估揭示了系统性的跨语言对齐差距：有用性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个经人工验证、文化情境化的乌尔都语3H对齐基准套件Pak3H，通过人工文化适配流程揭示了LLM因文化错配而产生的系统性跨语言对齐差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Pak3H, the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for 3H alignment, revealing systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps in LLMs caused by cultural mismatch.
